_about: The build's one configuration (S3.1 D15): packaging/Surasura.spec and package_app.py read it, never a settings.json. modules: which optional modules ship (2.5.0 shipped junban, koe, youtube_downloader; koe is left out from the 2.9 alpha and 3.0 on, its code kept in the private repo: Sonic 2026-10-23); koe also needs its folder; a module left out is checked absent from the built programs. release.telemetry_url: the telemetry receiver update.json names (the app keeps it for its next heartbeat; the build's .env TELEMETRY_URL is the fallback). parts: update.json's parts (D4; tsubasa: its program and its name tables, so a tsubasa bump is one small part, T1 B), first match wins: a path ending in / is a folder, "" every file left.
